title: Day 3 Thread: The Three Orbits Every High-Performance Team Falls Into
description: 1/ Gravity doesn't pull randomly. It creates predictable orbital patterns. 2/ The Pawn Orbit: Rigid, top-down, slow to change. The Architect's brute force. 3/ The Satellite Orbit: Agile but unaligned, risking fragmentation. 4/ The Binary Orbit: Two bodies (e.g., product & eng) in perfect, stable sync. This is the grace of well-personified gravity. Which orbit are you in?
